Hi Sam / Priya,

Great to meet with you both today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Demo scope: 45-minute technical demo focused on model latency, routing policies, and cost controls. Well leave 15 minutes for Q&A and next-step discussion.
- Proposed slots (PST): Tue Dec 8, 10:00-10:45am OR Tue Dec 8, 2:00-2:45pm. Please pick one that works for your team.
- Attendees: can you confirm who from HealthBridge should join? Based on the call I expect Security and Product PMs.
- Logistics: We can use Zoom or Google Meet — happy to follow your preference. Ill circulate the invite + agenda once we lock time.

Attached: redwood-demo-agenda.docx (short bullets + checklist).

If either slot works, Ill send an invite and include the join link.

Thanks,
Marissa

marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
